parts.text: In this experiment, you will investigate the refraction of light in a transparent block. You will determine a quantity known as the refractive index of the material of the block. Carry out the following instructions, using the separate ray-trace sheet provided. You may refer to Fig. 2.1 for guidance. Fig. 2.1

ms.text:
normal correct, near centre of AB
first pin distance at least 5.0 cm
first refracted line in correct place
second refracted line in correct place AND all lines thin, continuous and
straight
both measurements correct AND unit of cm or mm
1

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) Draw a line approximately 12 cm long and about 6 cm from the bottom of the ray-trace sheet. Label this line AB . Draw a normal to AB at its centre. Extend the normal for at least 15 cm above AB towards the top of the sheet. Label the normal NL . Label the point at which NL crosses AB with the letter C .

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) Place the transparent block so that its long side is on line AB , as shown in Fig. 2.1.

parts.label: i
parts.text: (c) (i) Carefully draw around the block.

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Place a pin P 1 at point C .

parts.label: iii
parts.text: (iii) View the image of P 1 through the block, from the direction indicated by the eye in Fig. 2.1. Place two pins P 2 and P 3 , a suitable distance apart, so that pins P 2 and P 3 and the image of P 1 all appear exactly one behind the other. Label the positions of P 2 and P 3 .

parts.label: iv
parts.text: (iv) Remove the block and pins from the ray-trace sheet.

parts.label: v
parts.text: (v) Label the point at which NL crosses the top edge of the block with the letter D .

parts.label: vi
parts.text: (vi) Draw a line joining the positions of P 2 and P 3 . Extend this line until it crosses NL . Label the point at which the line crosses NL with the letter E .

parts.label: iii
parts.text: (iii) Calculate a value n 1 for the refractive index of the block, using your values from (d)(i) and (d)(ii) and the equation n 1 = a b . n 1 = ...........................................................[1]

parts.label: i
parts.text: (e) (i) Place the block so that its shorter side is on line AB , as shown in Fig. 2.2. Fig. 2.2

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Repeat steps (c)(i) to (c)(iv) .

parts.label: iii
parts.text: (iii) Label the point at which NL crosses the top edge of the block with the letter F .

parts.label: iv
parts.text: (iv) Draw a line joining the new positions of P 2 and P 3 . Extend this line until it crosses NL . Label the point at which the line crosses NL with the letter G .

parts.label: iii
parts.text: (iii) Calculate a second value n 2 for the refractive index of the block, using your values from (f)(i) and (f)(ii) and the equation n 2 = c d . n 2 = ............................................................... [1]
